source_records.source_context: OpenAI first reported that some iOS users could encounter 403 errors while loading or using ChatGPT conversations. Later updates identified elevated conversation, sign-up, and sign-in errors affecting iOS and macOS, followed by account-creation and password-update errors. OpenAI reported that mitigations restored conversation and sign-in access and marked the incident resolved at 3:28 PM on 12 July 2026.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: The selected evidence reports: OpenAI first reported that some iOS users could encounter 403 errors while loading or using ChatGPT conversations. Later updates identified elevated conversation, sign-up, and sign-in errors affecting iOS and macOS, followed by account-creation and password-update errors. OpenAI reported that mitigations restored conversation and sign-in access and marked the incident resolved at 3:28 PM on 12 July 2026.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: A client-specific 403 symptom expanded into conversation, sign-up, sign-in, account-creation, and password-update errors, illustrating how an authorization-coded message can mask broader service degradation.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: For CAM, this occurrence shows that a client-specific 403 symptom expanded into conversation, sign-up, sign-in, account-creation, and password-update errors, illustrating how an authorization-coded message can mask broader service degradation. Controls should preserve evidence, authority state, escalation and contestability across the full affected pathway.
